## Research
- [Do fair value gaps work? We tested 23,773 FVGs](https://qaziforextips.com/research-do-fair-value-gaps-work.html): QFT Research report 1. 23,773 fair value gaps on XAUUSD and EURUSD (2023–2025) compared with random zones of the same size: a limit at the 50% CE line beat random zones in 8 of 8 M5/M15 tests (31% vs 28% at 1:2), a plain touch-and-bounce did not (42% vs 41%), trend and killzone filters did not help, and the CE trade alone was about −0.07R before costs. Method, limitations and a CSV summary included.

- [How to make money in forex: who wins, who loses (Lesson 0.2)](https://qaziforextips.com/lesson-how-to-make-money-in-forex.html): $100 at 10% a day for 30 days would be about $1,745, which is only maths, not a real result; 6 players in a $9.6 trillion/day market (BIS 2025) and the 2015 Swiss franc shock; profit comes from losers and from hedgers; losers' money goes to fees (spread/commission/swap), the broker (B-book), better traders and scams; after fees the total is negative; regulated brokers' warnings say about 60–80% of retail accounts lose; a small account is for learning; risk 2–3% on $50–$500, 1% or less on bigger accounts; 10 losses in a row at 1%/3%/20% = −9.6%/−26%/−89%.
- [Forex scams: how to spot fake signal groups and guaranteed profit (Lesson 0.3)](https://qaziforextips.com/lesson-forex-scams-signal-groups.html): a scammer earns from you, not the market (VIP fees, unregulated B-book broker commission, "account management" deposits, fake withdrawal fees); NCCIA received 150,000+ complaints in 2025, about 82,000 financial fraud; the 5 steps of a scam: bait (guaranteed profit), trust (free signals, winning screenshots), pressure ("only 10 seats left"), your money in their hands (their broker, your login, a personal account), the trap (fake dashboard profit, "pay tax / unlock fee" before withdrawal); hidden 6th step: the recovery scam (FCA); 5 checks before sending money; if scammed: stop paying, save evidence, tell your bank, report (Pakistan NCCIA 1799, India 1930), change passwords.
- [What is forex trading? (Lesson 1)](https://qaziforextips.com/lesson-what-is-forex-trading.html): forex means foreign exchange; about $9.6 trillion traded per day (BIS, April 2025); profit or loss comes from the price difference (money changer example); prices move with demand and supply; learn and use a demo account before real money.

- [Is this a valid CRT marking on H4](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-crt-marking-mistakes-h4.html): common Candle Range Theory marking mistakes on H4: range lines must be one candle's high and low wick to wick; valid CRT needs a sweep and close back inside; a close outside is a breakout; skip overlapping candles; enter on lower-timeframe MSS or FVG.
- [Whose price action strategy is the best](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-best-price-action-strategy-how-to-choose.html): how to choose a price action strategy: no single mentor's strategy is best; all price action meets at structure, levels, liquidity and momentum; pick clear written rules that fit your time, backtest 100 trades, demo 2-3 months, do not switch weekly.
- [Market structure, BOS, CHoCH and IDM](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-learn-market-structure-bos-choch-idm.html): the order to learn Smart Money Concepts: market structure (HH/HL/LH/LL) first, then BOS and CHoCH confirmed by body close, then inducement (IDM), then order blocks and FVGs.
- [My strategy works, so why am I not consistently profitable](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-consistent-profit-risk-not-strategy.html): why a working strategy is not consistently profitable: average loss bigger than average win; fixes are fixed 1% risk per trade, a daily loss limit (stop after two losses), never increasing the lot to recover, and checking the journal.
- [Gold is falling on the weekend](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-gold-weekend-price-monday-gap.html): why gold charts move on weekends (spot market closed; weekend products with low liquidity), that a Monday gap cannot be predicted, and how to protect open trades: smaller lot or close Friday, SL can fill beyond its level, avoid wide Monday spread.
- [MT5](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-mt5-sync-drawings-multiple-charts.html): MT5 does not copy drawings between chart windows; use a sync objects indicator from the MQL5 Code Base on every chart, or keep one chart and switch timeframes with all timeframes ticked in the object properties; same pair only.
- [Has the retracement started](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-retracement-started-how-to-know.html): how to tell a retracement has started in a downtrend: no new lower low on M15/H1 and a body close above the last lower high; retracements often retest the broken zone; do not buy just because price fell a lot.
- [Are 100 trades enough to backtest one strategy](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-backtest-100-trades-enough.html): whether 100 trades are enough to backtest: a sensible minimum for one setup if they cover trend, range and news conditions; then check win rate with average RR, the longest losing streak and drawdown, and forward test on demo.
- [How to backtest a forex strategy](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-how-to-backtest-step-by-step.html): how to backtest a forex strategy in 4 steps: write one setup's rules (entry, SL, target); replay the chart candle by candle without looking ahead; log every trade in a journal; judge win rate and RR only after about 100 trades, then demo forward-test.
- [Can gold fall to 3500](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-will-gold-fall-to-3500.html): whether gold can fall to 3500, answered without a prediction: read daily/weekly structure for lower highs and lower lows, mark strong support zones, trade only your setup with a stop loss, and ask how much you lose if wrong.
- [Split your risk into two entries: half on the first confirmation, half on the next close](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-split-risk-two-entries.html): Splitting the risk of one trade into two entries (half on M1 confirmation, half on the M5 close) with one stop; total still 1%; not averaging down; breakeven is not a loss.
- [Candle psychology: how to read the candles before you decide buy or sell](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-candle-psychology-buy-or-sell.html): Candle psychology: decide buy or sell from the whole sequence, reading structure, wicks, body size and closes; enter on the retest of the broken range, not the breakout candle; check the higher timeframe.
- [How to identify a real momentum candle](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-momentum-candle-4-rules.html): momentum candle (Dr. Qazi's 4 rules): ~90% body with tiny wicks; bigger than the last 2-3 candles and engulfs them (avoid a single candle that dominates the chart = news spike); obvious at a glance; must stand out from small neighbours; three same-colour candles together can count.
- [RSI divergence with price action](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-divergence-price-action-double-confirmation.html): RSI divergence + price action: never enter on divergence alone; divergence + double bottom + momentum candle = enter (don't wait for RSI 50); only double bottom = wait for trendline break; only divergence = wait for RSI 50; skip single-confirmation trades.
- [CRT in a bullish and a bearish trend: classic CRT vs CRT breakout](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-crt-classic-vs-breakout.html): CRT classic vs breakout: buy and sell steps in both trends, classic (sweep and close inside, reversal) vs breakout (close outside, continuation), example plan, back-test each model separately.
- [Back-test results are good, but live I overtrade: how to fix it](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-backtest-good-live-overtrading.html): Back-test good, live overtrading: why it happens and 6 fixes (one tested setup, session filter on the back-test, pending orders and alerts, daily trade limit, stop after two losses, decide only after 50 live trades).
- [Buying a 100K prop firm challenge for $99? Check these 4 things first](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-prop-firm-check-before-buying.html): Prop firm check before buying a challenge: no firm recommendations; 4 checks (history and payout proof, drawdown and news rules, very cheap offers, two months on demo with the same rules), drawdown maths at 1% risk.
- [Why did this buy setup fail? A big green candle in a downtrend](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-why-setup-failed-against-trend.html): Why a buy setup failed in a downtrend: the trend was down, the last lower high never broke, a close below the range low invalidated it, no M15 confirmation; the with-trend sell alternative.
- [A buy-side CHoCH on the daily chart](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-choch-daily-buy-entry.html): after a buy-side CHoCH on the daily chart: it is only the first sign; confirm with a body close; wait for the pullback and a higher low; enter on H4/H1 structure break with SL below the higher low; a new lower low means the CHoCH failed (possible IDM).
- ["Even my good trades are going the wrong way"](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-good-trades-losing-risk-management.html): when even good trades keep losing: a good trade follows the rules regardless of result; 5-6 losses in a row are normal at 50% win rate; check market phase (trend/range/news); review the last 20 trades in the journal; halve risk until rhythm returns.
- [Managing a trade when you are away from the screen](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-trade-management-away-from-screen.html): managing a trade when away from the screen: write the management plan before entry (half off at TP1, SL to breakeven), place TP or breakeven before leaving, same rules every day, keep the daily loss limit, journal every loss; partial close/breakeven tools help.
- [CRT (candle range theory)](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-crt-candle-range-theory.html): CRT (candle range theory): second candle must close inside the first candle's range (outside = breakout); SL behind the sweep wick; first target the other side; range candle D1/H4/H2/H1, entry M15/M5 at OB/FVG; EURUSD 2H example; back-test first.
- [FVG entry](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-fvg-entry-wait-for-retest.html): FVG entry: do not enter as soon as the gap forms; wait for price to return and a rejection candle, enter next candle with a tighter stop; if price never returns, skip; big engulfing = wait for 50%/retest, normal engulfing = entry at close; back-test both.
- [Sold the breakdown, but TP only came after a retest and a double top](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-breakdown-retest-double-top.html): selling a trendline breakdown: TP came late because the break candle was weak and support sat just below, so price retested twice and formed a double top; better entry: wait for the retest, enter on rejection or double top, SL above it.
- [Which timeframe should you judge a candle pattern on](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-candle-pattern-which-timeframe.html): which timeframe to judge candle patterns on: the timeframe of your level (daily/H4); read rejection vs momentum at the level; enter on H1/M15 with confirmation; never decide on M1/M5 alone; bigger timeframe = stronger signal.
- [Is forex a scam](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-is-forex-a-scam.html): is forex a scam? the currency market is real; the shortcut is the scam; where real scams are (fixed profit, account managers, signal sellers, unregulated brokers); 4 rules: emotions, money management with daily target, minimum 1:2, price action.
- [Charts first, fee later](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-forex-strategy-seller-scam.html): the 'charts first, fee later' trap in forex groups; why winning screenshots prove nothing; a strategy only works if it fits your psychology and your money/risk plan matches its back-test (worked losing-streak example); red flags.
- [Order block trade plan](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-order-block-trade-plan.html): can you trade an order block? 4 checks (strong move and BOS, unmitigated, higher-timeframe trend, lower-timeframe confirmation), stop beyond the block, 1:2 minimum, example plan.
- [Liquidity indicator in forex](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-liquidity-indicator-forex.html): why no indicator can measure liquidity in spot forex; where stops really sit (previous day high/low, equal highs/lows, session ranges, swings, round numbers); trading the sweep.
- [Why support and resistance fails](https://qaziforextips.com/qa-why-support-and-resistance-fails.html): the answer is in the candles: momentum vs weak breakouts, repeated rejections, retests; real vs fake breakout table; a practice assignment.
